suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as association risk. Require a documented hiatal hernia and separately confirmed Barrett's esophagus; use as association/risk evidence only. Meta-analysis does not by itself establish chronology or individual causation; GERD and other factors remain important. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Hiatal Hernia and Barrett's Esophagus
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
